mobbin:f6612862-77f9-4b6c-9ed5-4416ad9e8.summary: From In-store home, user starts Scan&Go, scans into a running tally, reviews My Items, is redirected to pay at a physical checkout with a pending QR, and finishes on a dated receipt.
steal: Session chrome (steps 3–4): live $total | N Items tally; Scan an item primary; keypad/manual barcode fallback beside dismiss.
After scan (step 5): My Items list with Continue to Payment vs Scan next item vs Use my lists — keep scanning or finalize.
Exception handoff (steps 7–8): Information banner forces Pay at Scan&Go Checkout; Payment Pending shows kiosk QR plus I've scanned my code.
Closure (step 9): receipt with itemized list, store/POS/transaction ids, timestamp — audit trail after auto checkout.
avoid: Retail payment/rewards steps (Adding Rewards, Visa checkout) — Essentials needs session/room assignment, not purchase.
mobbin:f6612862-77f9-4b6c-9ed5-4416ad9e8.fit: Strong check-out-auto analog for barcode check-out of kits/consumables during a scenario: scan loop, running count, optional list attach, then physical confirm via QR and a durable usage receipt.
